overview.summary: The canary_cmake extension provides CMake and CTest integration. It can generate Canary jobs from CTestTestfile.cmake files and provides CMake helper functions for generating .pyt tests.

ctest.summary: CTest tests are discovered by running ctest --show-only=json-v1 and transforming CTest test metadata into Canary JobSpecIR objects.

supported_properties.RESOURCE_GROUPS: Converted into resource group metadata and resource parameters.
supported_properties.FIXTURES_CLEANUP: Used to resolve fixture cleanup dependencies.

post_processing.finish_ctest: Applies pass, fail, skip, skip return code, and WILL_FAIL logic after job execution.
post_processing.setup_ctest: Sets CTEST_RESOURCE_GROUP_* variables for jobs with resource groups.

functions.add_canary_test: Generate a .pyt test from a CMake command or script.
functions.write_canary_config: Write canary.yaml with build and compiler metadata.
